# Lucky Summer Ward

Lucky Summer Ward is a ward in Ruaraka Constituency, Nairobi County, Kenya. It has a population of around 30,000 people and covers 1.95 km2.
Victor Omondi Ochola, also known as Ringo, represents the ward in the Nairobi City County Assembly, and Sospeter Anduru serves as the Ward Administrator. Lucky Summer Ward was formerly part of the Kasarani Constituency.
Since assuming office, Ringo has overseen several development initiatives within the ward, including the creation of job opportunities for youth, the enhancement of local security, and the installation of security lights. Residents have noted significant positive changes in the ward attributed to his leadership.
